g.text: ELECTRICAL: FEEDER POWER AND CONTROL (TYPICAL n = 1..9)
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-212 Bin screw feeder (built in house, 9 off) · rev B
UL 508A practice, NEC 430 / 430.102 (disconnect in sight); 75 °C Cu
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: POWER (one feeder shown; repeat for n = 1..9)
L2 230 V 1-ph from MS-P1 dosing bus
on the ring leg beside bin n
Isolator OFF → aux opens first → DI1 drops → drive stops on the ramp before the main poles break (no switching under load).
PLC sees 'not enabled' over Modbus status and skips the bin; MES shows 'feeder n isolated'.
SAFETY (from plant safety relay SR-P1, DH-ELE-P1-003)
E-stop or dosing-room guard → SR-P1 drops KM-DOS → all 9 drives lose supply (stop cat. 0).
KM-DOS mirror contact 21-22 to SR-P1 feedback loop (EDM).
If the drives bought have STO, wire STO1/STO2 from SR-P1 instead and keep KM-DOS as the supply switch.
RS-485 MODBUS RTU (W-P30, Belden 3105A, daisy chain)
D+ / D- twisted pair, SG to drain; drain bonded at the PLC end only; no stubs > 0.3 m; 120 Ω at the far end only.
Safety contactor 2-pole 25 A AC-3, 24 V DC coil, mirror aux (feeder drive supply)
MCB 2-pole C 16 A, 10 kA (1 per 2 drives; Q25 feeds drive 9 only)
AC drive 0.5 HP 230 V 1-ph in / 3-ph out, RS-485 Modbus RTU (P1-226)
Motor isolator 16 A lockable + early-break NO aux (P1-248)
Gearmotor 0.25 kW 230/460 V Δ/Y, 1.3 A at 230 V (P1-216)
Termination 120 Ω 0.25 W at the last node (blender drive P1-336)
1. Load: 9 x 1.3 A motors, drives 1-ph input ≈ 4.4 A each at full load; one feeder runs at a time (DosingStation.st), so
2. Disconnect in sight (NEC 430.102(B)): isolator Q-21n at each bin; lockable OFF, used for LOTO before opening the tail
3. Cable lengths ~15 m [50 ft] from MS-P1 (confirm on site); VFD cable max 50 m without output reactor (GS21 manual).
4. Bond the barrel and gearmotor to PE (< 10 Ω) through the motor cable G/Y and the bin ring.
